read_dispositions.READ_COMPATIBLE_V1: Exact known tag and family-compatible offline structure; does not attest source/root/author/semantic truth
read_dispositions.REJECT_UNVERSIONED_OR_UNKNOWN: Missing, mistyped or future schema tag; no implicit v1 or newest-version fallback
read_dispositions.REJECT_INVALID_V1: Known tag with wrong family, illegal field, identity mismatch, proof assertion, size or BOM
read_dispositions.REJECT_UNREADABLE_INPUT: Input inaccessible, unsafe path, UTF-8/JSON/duplicate/depth failure

versioning.distinct_namespaces: Use explicit family tag + .vN; construction package V4.68, embedded CLI product_version V4.60 and its build R150 are NOT schema versions
versioning.additive_changes: Do not relax strict saved-record v1 parser; ship an opt-in declared new schema and explicit version-selected adapter
versioning.breaking_changes: Use new version tag with documented typed defaults only for new reader-view fields; no reinterpretation of v1 persisted claims
versioning.unknown_fields: Envelope extra properties only as opaque uninterpreted data; reject extras in v1 saved/draft/owner/packet fixed structures
versioning.no_version_tag: FAIL_CLOSED; never infer from a filename, JSON shape or CLI product/build
versioning.normalization: NO_PERSISTED_NORMALIZATION; never parse then reserialize an original ci- content-addressed record

migration.identity_only: Known validated v1 to same v1 = no-op, no writes
migration.future_candidate: Any v2 transition requires a separately reviewed version-specific transformation, stable input SHA/ID, opt-in preview and explicit write authorization; NONE exists in EC-158
migration.destination_policy: When authorized in a future EC, new immutable content-addressed object only, never replace prior owner or record; require distinct new ID and no-clobber placement
migration.rollback_policy: Retain original bytes and IDs. Rollback changes active selection/pointer only in a future separately authorized versioned mechanism; never silently delete/overwrite historical data
preconditions: Re-evaluate SECURITY_BOUNDARIES.json permission and main-root/Git constraints
Verify exact original record bytes/ID and source-provenance limitations
Do not migrate existing business source/Git objects or publish to a remote service
Reject any unknown version/field/default rather than speculative conversion

scope_limitations: Offline tool does not invoke PowerShell, Git, CodeShow or CodeSave; it does not authenticate a repo, data origin or stable snapshots
Offline validation is a shape/identity subset; native Reconcile and CodeValidate include more source-dependent constraints
A matching SHA is ordinary corruption detection, not a signature or trusted timestamp
No Windows/macOS/PowerShell7 native, E63-E66 performance or remote/provider/end-to-end acceptance was performed
